historical_record.description: Matson erected this office building within the five years or so before 1975, one of several new corporate offices then going up on the South of Market waterfront blocks.

unknowns: The assessor's roll dates the building to 1967; the 1975 environmental report has Matson erecting it within roughly five years of that report.
The environmental report files this address under assessor's block 3710; the address resolves to block 3712.
